subject: ela
intro: Pick how point of view shapes the story.

items.prompt:
A first-person narrator uses the word:
A) I
B) they
C) it

An all-knowing narrator is called:
A) omniscient
B) first-person
C) silent

Point of view affects:
A) what the reader learns and how events are described
B) the page count
C) the font
items.answer: A) what the reader learns and how events are described

steps: POV shapes the telling. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) what the reader learns and how events are described

items.prompt:
Read.

'I knew the new kid was trouble the moment I saw his smirk.'

This first-person view shows:
A) the kid is definitely bad
B) the narrator's personal, possibly biased, opinion
C) everyone's thoughts
items.answer: B) the narrator's personal, possibly biased, opinion

steps: First-person = one view. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) the narrator's personal, possibly biased, opinion

items.prompt:
What can an OMNISCIENT narrator do?
A) reveal more than one character's private thoughts
B) know only the main character's thoughts
C) know nothing
items.answer: A) reveal more than one character's private thoughts

solution.answer: A) reveal more than one character's private thoughts

items.prompt:
If a story is told by the VILLAIN, the events might be described to:
A) favor the villain's side
B) always praise the hero
C) hide the villain

steps: Narrators are one-sided. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A story is told in first person by a shy boy who misreads a girl's kindness as pity. How does this point of view affect the reader?
A) The reader only sees the boy's (mistaken) interpretation
B) The reader knows the girl's true thoughts
C) The reader learns everyone's feelings
items.answer: A) The reader only sees the boy's (mistaken) interpretation

steps: First-person limits the view. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) The reader only sees the boy's (mistaken) interpretation

items.prompt:
Why might an author choose an OMNISCIENT narrator instead of first person?
A) to show the thoughts and feelings of several characters
B) to hide all information
C) to use the word 'I'
items.answer: A) to show the thoughts and feelings of several characters

steps: Omniscient reveals more. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) to show the thoughts and feelings of several characters
